game_title: Max Finder Derby – Canopy Walkway Streak
game_concept: A rhythm puzzle set in Mystic Forest – Canopy Walkway, rope walkways in the canopy: the fairy gardener must handle bramble beasts while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Max Finder Derby: Track the biggest value seen so far while looping over contestants.
theme: Mystic Forest – Canopy Walkway: rope walkways in the canopy
core_gameplay_loop: In Canopy Walkway, repeat each round: Track the biggest value seen so far while looping over contestants. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the best value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 12 consecutive correct decisions about best to power up the fairy gardener and open the vine bridge.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 7 (applied tier): Max Finder Derby
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how best changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against bramble beasts in Canopy Walkway.
